intent: Open with the strongest defensible risk, build concern with evidence, restore the missing context, then ask a personal question.

templates.hook: {verified event}. Here is what that means for your {everyday stake}.
templates.escalation: First {fact}. Then {fact}. But one detail changes the picture.
templates.turn: Here is what that headline leaves out.
templates.question: Would you {option A}, or {option B}?

examples: You deleted the chat. Does that mean the company deleted it too?
Here is the distinction: a retention rule is not a promise that every conversation will be read.
Would you put a work document in a chatbot?
conventions: Address one viewer as you; contractions sound natural.
Keep the original act IDs. Resolve every opening alarm with evidence and state the limits.
Keep title_level alto: short, concrete tension; a named company or figure requires a source.
Keep the historical before/after comparison, using only verified figures; do not invent a US example to replace the source.
sounds_false: In this video we will explore the fascinating world of AI.
Your chats WILL be sold: certainty that the evidence does not support.
A breathless cable-news delivery from start to finish.

overrides.name: Evidence-led alarm, context, then a question

alto.name: High tension
alto.description: A short, concrete warning with a factual basis.

node_tech: Deleting a chat is not the whole story

question.delivery_note: Lower and slower, as if speaking to one person. Pause briefly before the question.

instructions: Keep hook, concern, turn, evidence and one final question.
Give the resolution enough time; do not compress it into a disclaimer.
